messages:
Priya: Customer reported internal-api.prod.svc.redwood.internal started returning NXDOMAIN from their VPC ~30m ago, causing 503s on their end. Anyone else seeing DNS failures?

Ethan: I see a spike in 5xx and DNS NXDOMAINs to that name from the customer's CIDR in CloudWatch logs. Dig from our bastion resolves fine, but dig from their VPC -> NXDOMAIN.

Ethan: dig +short internal-api.prod.svc.redwood.internal @10.0.2.2

```
;; ->>HEADER<<- opcode: QUERY, status: NXDOMAIN, id: 12345
```

Marcos: Did we recently touch private hosted zones? We ran that hosted-zone rename/cleanup script earlier today.

Priya: Their report says it coincided with the rename. Could be an overlapping private zone or a wrong VPC association.

Ethan: Running quick check — hosted zone for prod-api shows VPC associated to vpc-0staging (staging account) instead of the customer's prod VPC. Snip: 

```
$ aws route53 get-hosted-zone --id Z123ABC
{
  "HostedZone": { ... },
  "VPCs": [{"VPCRegion":"us-west-2","VPCId":"vpc-0staging"}]
}
```

Marcos: Yep, that explains the shadowing. The rename script created a new hosted zone and accidentally associated it to the wrong VPC/account.

Marcos: Proposed remediation (minimal blast radius):
1) In customer account run:
   aws route53 create-vpc-association-authorization --hosted-zone-id Z123ABC --vpc VPCRegion=us-west-2,VPCId=vpc-0prod
2) In customer prod account run:
   aws route53 associate-vpc-with-hosted-zone --hosted-zone-id Z123ABC --vpc VPCRegion=us-west-2,VPCId=vpc-0prod
3) Remove the incorrect association from the staging VPC after prod association is healthy:
   aws route53 disassociate-vpc-from-hosted-zone --hosted-zone-id Z123ABC --vpc VPCRegion=us-west-2,VPCId=vpc-0staging
4) Ask customer to flush resolver caches / restart service or wait TTL (~60s)

Marcos: I'll create the association auth and run step 2 in ~15m, posting outputs. Will keep change window small.

deploy-bot: Incident created: INC-642 assigned to @Marcos. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/dns-hostedzone-misassoc

oncall-infra: Quick note — also double-check cross-account resolver rules and shared VPCs; if they use Route53 Resolver inbound endpoints we may need to update rules to prefer private hosted zone.

Priya: Notified customer of the plan and ETA. Will update once Marcos posts results. Thanks everyone :pray:
